panels.description: Collector login time for the selected trip. Choose a trip above the dashboard.

targets.queryText: SELECT timeline_start_ms AS "Trip start" FROM trip WHERE trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND device_id = ${device:sqlstring} LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT timeline_start_ms AS "Trip start" FROM trip WHERE trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND device_id = ${device:sqlstring} LIMIT 1

panels.title: Trip start

panels.description: Collector-observed duration of the selected trip.

targets.queryText: SELECT (timeline_end_ms - timeline_start_ms) / 1000.0 AS "Duration" FROM trip WHERE trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND device_id = ${device:sqlstring} LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (timeline_end_ms - timeline_start_ms) / 1000.0 AS "Duration" FROM trip WHERE trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND device_id = ${device:sqlstring} LIMIT 1

panels.title: Duration

panels.description: Distance is not materialised in the current SQLite contract; this value remains unavailable until the importer stores a lossless distance field.

targets.queryText: SELECT NULL AS "Distance" FROM trip WHERE trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND device_id = ${device:sqlstring} LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT NULL AS "Distance" FROM trip WHERE trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND device_id = ${device:sqlstring} LIMIT 1

panels.title: Distance

panels.description: Time-average speed in miles per hour. OBD speed is preferred, with GPS as the fallback. OBD values older than 15 seconds are excluded.

targets.queryText: SELECT AVG(m.numeric_value * 0.621371) AS "Average speed (mph)" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x10D' AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT AVG(m.numeric_value * 0.621371) AS "Average speed (mph)" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x10D' AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)

panels.title: Average speed

panels.description: Highest observed speed in miles per hour, with GPS used when OBD speed is unavailable. OBD values older than 15 seconds are excluded.

targets.queryText: SELECT MAX(m.numeric_value * 0.621371) AS "Maximum speed (mph)" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x10D' AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT MAX(m.numeric_value * 0.621371) AS "Maximum speed (mph)" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x10D' AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)

panels.title: Maximum speed

panels.description: Highest engine RPM in the selected trip and time range.

targets.queryText: SELECT MAX(m.numeric_value) AS "Peak engine speed" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x10C' AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT MAX(m.numeric_value) AS "Peak engine speed" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x10C' AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)

panels.title: Peak engine speed

panels.description: Estimated first fuel-level value from the final sample and gauge delta over the selected range.

targets.queryText: SELECT m.numeric_value AS "Fuel at start" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x12F' ORDER BY s.sequence ASC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT m.numeric_value AS "Fuel at start" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x12F' ORDER BY s.sequence ASC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Fuel at start

panels.description: Latest fuel-level sample in the selected time range.

targets.queryText: SELECT m.numeric_value AS "Fuel at end" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x12F' ORDER BY s.sequence DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT m.numeric_value AS "Fuel at end" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x12F' ORDER BY s.sequence DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Fuel at end

panels.description: Start minus end fuel-tank percentage. Sensor quantisation means short trips may show zero or noise.

targets.queryText: SELECT (first.numeric_value - last.numeric_value) AS "Fuel level change" FROM (SELECT m.numeric_value FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x12F' ORDER BY s.sequence ASC LIMIT 1) AS first, (SELECT m.numeric_value FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x12F' ORDER BY s.sequence DESC LIMIT 1) AS last
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (first.numeric_value - last.numeric_value) AS "Fuel level change" FROM (SELECT m.numeric_value FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x12F' ORDER BY s.sequence ASC LIMIT 1) AS first, (SELECT m.numeric_value FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x12F' ORDER BY s.sequence DESC LIMIT 1) AS last

panels.title: Peak braking

panels.description: Maximum fresh engine coolant temperature exposed by the ECU. Values older than 15 seconds are excluded.

targets.queryText: SELECT MAX(m.numeric_value) AS "Maximum coolant" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x105' AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT MAX(m.numeric_value) AS "Maximum coolant" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x105' AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)

panels.title: Maximum coolant

panels.description: One row per collector trip in the dashboard time range. Use the Trip selector for a detailed route and metric investigation.

targets.queryText: SELECT trip_id AS "Trip", device_id AS "Vehicle", datetime(timeline_start_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Timeline start", datetime(timeline_end_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Timeline end", timestamp_quality AS "Capture timestamp quality", time_basis AS "Display time basis", sample_count AS "Samples", gap_count AS "Gaps", archive_path AS "Archive" FROM trip WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND timeline_start_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY timeline_start_ms DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT trip_id AS "Trip", device_id AS "Vehicle", datetime(timeline_start_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Timeline start", datetime(timeline_end_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Timeline end", timestamp_quality AS "Capture timestamp quality", time_basis AS "Display time basis", sample_count AS "Samples", gap_count AS "Gaps", archive_path AS "Archive" FROM trip WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND timeline_start_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY timeline_start_ms DESC

panels.title: Trip index

panels.description: GPS route for the selected trip and time range. No line is shown until a valid outdoor fix is received.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, s.latitude AS "Latitude", s.longitude AS "Longitude", s.gps_speed_kph * 0.621371 AS "GPS speed (mph)", s.gps_heading_degrees AS "Heading", (SELECT numeric_value * 0.621371 FROM sample_metric WHERE device_id = s.device_id AND trip_id = s.trip_id AND sequence = s.sequence AND pid = '0x10D') AS "OBD speed (mph)", (SELECT numeric_value FROM sample_metric WHERE device_id = s.device_id AND trip_id = s.trip_id AND sequence = s.sequence AND pid = '0x10C') AS "RPM", (SELECT numeric_value FROM sample_metric WHERE device_id = s.device_id AND trip_id = s.trip_id AND sequence = s.sequence AND pid = '0x12F') AS "Fuel %", s.sequence AS "Sample", s.device_monotonic_ms AS "Device monotonic (ms)", s.collector_received_ms AS "Collector receipt (per-sample, if available)", s.archive_mtime_ms AS "Archive mtime (ms)", s.capture_utc_ms AS "Capture UTC (ms)", s.timestamp_quality AS "Capture timestamp quality", s.time_basis AS "Display time basis" FROM sample AS s WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.latitude IS NOT NULL AND s.longitude IS NOT NULL AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY sequence
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, s.latitude AS "Latitude", s.longitude AS "Longitude", s.gps_speed_kph * 0.621371 AS "GPS speed (mph)", s.gps_heading_degrees AS "Heading", (SELECT numeric_value * 0.621371 FROM sample_metric WHERE device_id = s.device_id AND trip_id = s.trip_id AND sequence = s.sequence AND pid = '0x10D') AS "OBD speed (mph)", (SELECT numeric_value FROM sample_metric WHERE device_id = s.device_id AND trip_id = s.trip_id AND sequence = s.sequence AND pid = '0x10C') AS "RPM", (SELECT numeric_value FROM sample_metric WHERE device_id = s.device_id AND trip_id = s.trip_id AND sequence = s.sequence AND pid = '0x12F') AS "Fuel %", s.sequence AS "Sample", s.device_monotonic_ms AS "Device monotonic (ms)", s.collector_received_ms AS "Collector receipt (per-sample, if available)", s.archive_mtime_ms AS "Archive mtime (ms)", s.capture_utc_ms AS "Capture UTC (ms)", s.timestamp_quality AS "Capture timestamp quality", s.time_basis AS "Display time basis" FROM sample AS s WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.latitude IS NOT NULL AND s.longitude IS NOT NULL AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY sequence

panels.title: Trip route

panels.description: UK display units: OBD and GPS speed are shown in mph; RPM uses the right axis. Gaps remain visible instead of being invented.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10D' THEN m.numeric_value * 0.621371 END) AS "OBD speed (mph)", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10C' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Engine RPM", MAX(s.gps_speed_kph * 0.621371) AS "GPS speed (mph)" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10D' THEN m.numeric_value * 0.621371 END) AS "OBD speed (mph)", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10C' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Engine RPM", MAX(s.gps_speed_kph * 0.621371) AS "GPS speed (mph)" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Road speed and engine speed

panels.description: The current SQLite contract does not persist MEMS acceleration. The chart remains visible to show that this evidence is unavailable, not zero.

targets.queryText: SELECT timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, NULL AS "Acceleration (g)" FROM sample WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, NULL AS "Acceleration (g)" FROM sample WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Acceleration by device axis

panels.description: Only PIDs advertised by the ECU appear. Missing accelerator or torque series means unsupported, not zero.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x104' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Engine load", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x111' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Throttle" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x104' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Engine load", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x111' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Throttle" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Engine load and driver demand

panels.description: Coolant, intake, oil, catalyst and ambient temperatures, plus the logger enclosure, when exposed.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x105' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Coolant", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10F' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Intake temperature" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x105' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Coolant", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10F' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Intake temperature" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Thermal system

panels.description: Fuel gauge percentage and closed-loop trims stay on the primary axis. Equivalence ratio uses the right axis; fuel percentage is not a volume measurement.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x12F' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Fuel level", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid IN ('0x106', '0x107') THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Fuel trim" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x12F' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Fuel level", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid IN ('0x106', '0x107') THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Fuel trim" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Fuel level, trim and mixture

panels.description: Intake, fuel-rail, barometric and evaporative pressures with mass airflow on its own axis.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x110' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Mass airflow" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x110' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Mass airflow" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Airflow and pressure

panels.description: Satellite count and HDOP explain route quality; altitude uses the right axis.

targets.queryText: SELECT timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, gps_satellites AS "Satellites", gps_hdop AS "HDOP", gps_speed_kph * 0.621371 AS "GPS speed (mph)" FROM sample WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, gps_satellites AS "Satellites", gps_hdop AS "HDOP", gps_speed_kph * 0.621371 AS "GPS speed (mph)" FROM sample WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time

panels.title: GPS quality

panels.description: Fuel rate is shown directly when standard PID 0x5E is reported. The MAF estimate is a transparent petrol-only fallback (14.7:1 AFR, 745 g/L) and is not calibrated consumption; fuel percentage alone cannot produce efficiency.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x15E' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "ECU fuel rate", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x110' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Mass airflow" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x15E' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "ECU fuel rate", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x110' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Mass airflow" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Fuel rate and economy

panels.description: Every standard Mode 01 PID the vehicle advertised, with friendly metadata from kierandrewett/obd. 'Latest fresh' is blank when an ECU value is older than 15 seconds. A missing row means the ECU did not advertise that PID; it is never shown as zero.

targets.queryText: SELECT m.pid AS "PID", COUNT(m.numeric_value) AS "Samples", MIN(m.numeric_value) AS "Minimum", AVG(m.numeric_value) AS "Average", MAX(m.numeric_value) AS "Maximum" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY m.pid ORDER BY m.pid
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT m.pid AS "PID", COUNT(m.numeric_value) AS "Samples", MIN(m.numeric_value) AS "Minimum", AVG(m.numeric_value) AS "Average", MAX(m.numeric_value) AS "Maximum" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY m.pid ORDER BY m.pid

panels.title: Every ECU metric exposed by this vehicle

panels.description: Ignition timing, oxygen-sensor voltage and commanded air-fuel equivalence. These values help to investigate combustion behaviour; they are not a direct emissions test.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10E' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Timing advance", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x144' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Equivalence ratio" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10E' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Timing advance", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x144' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Equivalence ratio" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Combustion and exhaust

panels.description: Useful ECU lifetime and service counters. They are direct ECU reports, not values calculated from the short current trip.

targets.queryText: SELECT m.pid AS "PID", MAX(m.numeric_value) AS "Latest" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY m.pid ORDER BY m.pid
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT m.pid AS "PID", MAX(m.numeric_value) AS "Latest" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY m.pid ORDER BY m.pid

panels.title: ECU service and emissions counters

panels.description: Durable capture-time history from SQLite. This contract panel stays empty or unavailable until the freematics-history datasource and archive importer are provisioned; Prometheus cannot backfill expired samples.

targets.queryText: SELECT trip_id AS "Trip", device_id AS "Vehicle", datetime(timeline_start_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Timeline start", datetime(timeline_end_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Timeline end", timestamp_quality AS "Capture timestamp quality", time_basis AS "Display time basis", sample_count AS "Samples", archive_path AS "Archive" FROM trip WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND timeline_start_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY timeline_start_ms DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT trip_id AS "Trip", device_id AS "Vehicle", datetime(timeline_start_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Timeline start", datetime(timeline_end_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Timeline end", timestamp_quality AS "Capture timestamp quality", time_basis AS "Display time basis", sample_count AS "Samples", archive_path AS "Archive" FROM trip WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND timeline_start_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY timeline_start_ms DESC

panels.title: Durable trip archive (SQLite)

panels.description: Capture evidence from the durable archive. Unknown capture timestamps remain NULL; display time, archive mtime and device monotonic time are shown separately. Per-sample receipt lag is unavailable until the collector records a receipt ledger.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.sequence AS "Sample", t.timestamp_quality AS "Trip timestamp quality", s.timestamp_quality AS "Sample timestamp quality", s.device_monotonic_ms AS "Device monotonic (ms)", s.capture_utc_ms AS "Capture UTC (ms)", s.timeline_ms AS "Display time (ms)", s.time_basis AS "Display time basis", s.collector_received_ms AS "Collector receipt (per-sample, if available)", s.archive_mtime_ms AS "Archive mtime (ms)", NULL AS "Receipt lag (ms; not instrumented)", t.gap_count AS "Trip gaps" FROM sample AS s JOIN trip AS t ON t.device_id = s.device_id AND t.trip_id = s.trip_id WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY s.sequence LIMIT 5000
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.sequence AS "Sample", t.timestamp_quality AS "Trip timestamp quality", s.timestamp_quality AS "Sample timestamp quality", s.device_monotonic_ms AS "Device monotonic (ms)", s.capture_utc_ms AS "Capture UTC (ms)", s.timeline_ms AS "Display time (ms)", s.time_basis AS "Display time basis", s.collector_received_ms AS "Collector receipt (per-sample, if available)", s.archive_mtime_ms AS "Archive mtime (ms)", NULL AS "Receipt lag (ms; not instrumented)", t.gap_count AS "Trip gaps" FROM sample AS s JOIN trip AS t ON t.device_id = s.device_id AND t.trip_id = s.trip_id WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY s.sequence LIMIT 5000
